notes.title: Deploy steps
notes.body: Deploy with make deploy. It needs approval from a maintainer.

notes.title: Deploy days
notes.body: We deploy on Tuesdays. Hotfixes may go out any day.

notes.title: Deploy rollback
notes.body: Roll back with make rollback; it restores the previous image tag.

notes.title: Alerts
notes.body: Pager alerts fire when error rate exceeds 2 percent for 5 minutes.

notes.title: Alert routing
notes.body: Alerts go to the platform on-call first, then to the team lead after 15 minutes.
